title: Premium members in Lyon
statementMd:
List the names of premium-tier members who live in Lyon.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name FROM members WHERE tier = 'premium' AND city = 'Lyon';
```
